prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic outdoor lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult athletic woman with black hair tied in a low ponytail and a black casual sports cap. She is standing beside a sleek black car while opening the door, smiling brightly over her shoulder toward the camera. She wears a coordinated pink athletic outfit with a relaxed-fit pink T-shirt and fitted pink sport shorts, carries a stylish pink drawstring backpack and holds a blue water bottle and a small packaged drink carton. Set the scene in an outdoor parking area with soft greenery and natural tones in the background. Use soft natural daylight, realistic athletic fabric texture, natural body proportions, a moderate depth of field and an energetic confident active-lifestyle mood. Preserve the source candid car-door action, pink outfit, backpack, accessories and fresh outdoor setting without body-part emphasis.
